item.title: Portable AI Studio - Local AI for Chat, Images and Speech
item.description:
Portable AI Studio - Local AI for Chat, Images and Speech

Portable local AI interface for Windows, Linux, and macOS, combining GGUF language-model chat, Stable Diffusion image generation, Whisper transcription, and Kokoro text-to-speech. Includes model downloads and hardware-accelerated execution, with offline use once the required models and components are installed.

item.title: Blup - Publish Obsidian Notes as a Website
item.description:
Blup - Publish Obsidian Notes as a Website

Open-source publishing tool that turns an Obsidian folder into a Hugo-powered blog or product site. Supports offline writing and previews, GitHub note sync, and deployment to Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages, with built-in search, themes, and custom-domain support.

item.title: Pinchflat-NGX - Self-Hosted YouTube Media Manager
item.description:
Pinchflat-NGX - Self-Hosted YouTube Media Manager

Enhanced fork of Pinchflat for downloading and managing YouTube media, with a Material-design interface, PostgreSQL support, and OIDC single sign-on. Offers Docker deployment and optional local download staging before completed files are moved to the media library.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Yarrtube - Self-Hosted YouTube Channel and Playlist Downloader
item.description:
Yarrtube - Self-Hosted YouTube Channel and Playlist Downloader

Self-hosted service built on yt-dlp that monitors YouTube channels and public playlists, automatically downloading new videos to local storage. Runs via Docker on a NAS or computer, with browser playback and support for Plex, Jellyfin, and Kodi.

item.title: Helpdock - Self-Hosted Customer Support Platform
item.description:
Helpdock - Self-Hosted Customer Support Platform

Open-source alternative to Zendesk and Zoho Desk combining support tickets, a help center, a live-chat widget, and grounded AI assistance. Supports multiple brands from a single self-hosted deployment, bringing customer-support tools together in one platform.

item.title: Gofer - Self-Hosted Email, Contacts and Calendar
item.description:
Gofer - Self-Hosted Email, Contacts and Calendar

Self-hosted, multi-account email client supporting JMAP, IMAP, and SMTP, plus direct Gmail and Outlook API integrations. Includes contacts and calendar features, with a web interface built using Go, templ, and HTMX and SQLite for storage.

item.title: DailyHub - Self-Hosted Projects, Tasks and Habits Dashboard
item.description:
DailyHub - Self-Hosted Projects, Tasks and Habits Dashboard

Single-user productivity dashboard for managing multiple projects, tasks, and daily habits in one place. Runs locally or self-hosted using Next.js and SQLite, keeping data on your own machine without a cloud account, with npm and Docker deployment options.

item.title: Contrack - Self-Hosted Personal CRM and Contact Enrichment
item.description:
Contrack - Self-Hosted Personal CRM and Contact Enrichment

Self-hosted personal CRM for importing, deduplicating, enriching, and tracking personal and professional contacts. Combines relationship notes, follow-up reminders, birthdays, and private contact search, with optional AI-assisted profile enrichment and Docker deployment on your own machine or server.

item.title: Scrapling - Python Web Scraping and Crawling Framework
item.description:
Scrapling - Python Web Scraping and Crawling Framework

Python framework combining HTTP requests, browser-based JavaScript rendering, adaptive element tracking, and data extraction. Supports single-page scraping and concurrent crawls, with reusable sessions, proxy rotation, automatic retries, pause-and-resume support, and built-in data exports.

item.title: Folio - Git-Backed Team Wiki
item.description:
Folio - Git-Backed Team Wiki

Folio is a self-hosted team wiki where content lives as ordinary files in Git, with real-time collaborative editing, tables, whiteboards, offline support, and built-in AI and MCP integration. Run it with Docker; the repository includes its code and project documentation.
